name: @corbits-builder/presenter
description: Builds a slide deck and an approval package for one audience from the project's approved documents and its chosen design.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants to share or present the project to an audience, such as their CEO, an investor or a client, as a slide deck and an approval package.
builder.unless: They want a document written, or the thing itself built or changed.

present.when: The person wants a deck and approval package for an audience, once they have said who it is for, the decision they need and which approved documents it covers.
present.unless: The documents it would cover are not approved yet, or the person has not said who the audience is.

examples: present the plan to the client
I need sign-off from my CTO
